title: Open direct images with arbitrary finite allowable coefficients
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, let $A$ be a finite ring annihilated by
an integer invertible in $k$, and let $j:X\hookrightarrow Y$
be an open immersion of finite-type $k$-schemes. For every
$K\in D^b_c(X,A)$, one has $Rj_*K\in D^b_c(Y,A)$.
The notation refers to bounded constructible complexes, and ordinary derived categories.

proof.text: The existing source-library corollary AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.boundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerStar_of_isOpenImmersion_of_field in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.Finiteness.Deligne is already stated for every finite commutative coefficient ring of invertible exponent, rather than only the prime-field specialization recorded in cor-fin-deligne-open-over-field. Obtain HasInvertibleExponent A (Spec k) directly from N and the coefficient hypothesis. Apply that existing corollary to every constructible A-sheaf; no scalar conversion or primary filtration is needed in this module. The existing corollary is proved from the existing arbitrary-finite-coefficient source implementation of generic Deligne constructibility, whose proof remains an existing sorry.

Convert the finite-constant-value constructibility of every cohomology sheaf of K to the source-library IsConstructibleSheaf predicate using lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison. The explicit support interval [a,b] supplies DerivedCategory.IsGE K a and IsLE K b through DerivedCategory.isGE_iff and isLE_iff. Apply the existing proved boundedConstructible_obj_of_forall_singleFunctor lemma to the triangulated total derived direct-image functor and the sheaf assertion of step 1. That lemma inducts on the finite cohomological interval through truncation triangles and uses the constructible Serre theorem for triangulated closure; no spectral sequence or injective representative is introduced here.

Unpack the output standard t-structure bounds a,b and convert every constructible cohomology sheaf back to the finite-constant-value predicate using the same equivalence. Choose the explicit interval [min(a,b),max(a,b)]; the lower t-structure bound gives vanishing below its lower endpoint and the upper bound gives vanishing above its upper endpoint. This includes the zero complex, empty schemes, and the zero coefficient ring without additional hypotheses.

proof_origin.place: Existing arbitrary-finite-coefficient open-image sheaf corollary and proved finite truncation devissage; boundedness/constructibility conversion as in ProperBoundedConstructible.lean. Reuses the existing generic Deligne sorry; adds no theorem or hole.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $k$ be a field, let $A$ be a finite ring annihilated by
an integer invertible in $k$, and let $j:X\hookrightarrow Y$
be an open immersion of finite-type $k$-schemes. For every
$K\in D^b_c(X,A)$, one has $Rj_*K\in D^b_c(Y,A)$.

proof.text:
First let $K=F$ be a sheaf. Decompose its underlying finite
torsion group into its finitely many primary parts, and filter
the $\ell$-primary part by
$F\supset\ell F\supset\ell^2F\supset\cdots\supset0$.
These subsheaves and quotients are constructible by
[thm-constructible-serre]; each quotient is
annihilated by $\ell$. Its derived direct image is computed
over $\mathbf F_\ell$ by
[lem-fin-coefficients-forgetful-direct-image], and is bounded
constructible by [cor-fin-deligne-open-over-field].
The finite sequence of long exact cohomology sequences proves
the same assertion for the underlying finite additive sheaf of
$Rj_*F$, with a finite cohomological range. Its inherited
$A$-action preserves constructibility: on any stratum where
the additive sheaf is finite locally constant, the finitely many
endomorphisms defining the $A$-action are locally constant
matrices after an etale trivialization. Refining those
trivializations makes it a locally constant finite $A$-module
sheaf. Thus the assertion holds with its original coefficients.
For bounded $K$, use its finitely many cohomology sheaves and
the finite truncation triangles, equivalently
[thm-sp-truncation-e2]. The finite union of their ranges
bounds $Rj_*K$; kernels, cokernels and extensions preserve
constructibility by [thm-constructible-serre].
